name: @arhen/pi-core-skill-tool
description: Pi extension — opencode2-style skills: strips the built-in skill catalog from the system prompt and exposes skills via a single lazy `skill` tool. Agent auto-invokes, no user input, saves ~4.5K tokens/session.
